instruction: Candid street photograph, medium shot. On a city sidewalk lined with residential buildings, the woman with short curly hair and glasses (R1) on the left walks hand-in-hand with the person with short dark undercut hair (R2) on the right. R1, wearing an olive parka and purple leggings, smiles warmly at R2. R2, in a black denim jacket and green pants, holds R1's hand while carrying a towel and water bottle in the other hand. Natural daylight casts soft shadows across the scene.
